name: Question 9
problem:
By changing the order of integration in the following repeated integrals so that they are integrated first with respect to $x,$ then $y,$ and then $z,$ express the following sum as a single repeated integral.

$$
{\int }_{-2}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{y+2}}{\int }_{-z}^{{y}^{2}}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{2}^{6}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{6-y}}{\int }_{-z}^{{y}^{2}}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y
$$
